items.question: What sequential order governs the recitation of the fifty-letter matrix?
premises: The initial recitation proceeds in natural order.
A contrasting recitation proceeds in reverse order.
The reverse recitation follows immediately after the first.
items.inference: The fifty-letter matrix must be recited first in natural order and then immediately in reverse order.
